_comment: 场域精测七十二变：8结构原型（本相）× 9状态相位（时相）= 72。与梦境库同一套心法（见 knowledge/dream/axes.json），两处互通。本相由五维分数的形态归纳而来，不是分数高低——同样均分70，五维平齐(经纬)和五维锯齿(刃)是完全不同的两个人。时相由状态层推出。二轴正交：本相是地图，时相是你此刻在图上的位置。

archetypes.stanceZh: 单点极强，其余围绕它组织。强的那一项就是整个结构的主梁
archetypes.stanceEn: one dominant strength around which everything else organizes

archetypes.stanceZh: 五维接近平齐，没有明显主梁，靠彼此支撑
archetypes.stanceEn: near-even across dimensions, holding by mutual support rather than a main beam

archetypes.stanceZh: 高低反差极大，锋利，代价是薄
archetypes.stanceEn: extreme contrast between high and low — sharp, and thin for the same reason

archetypes.stanceZh: 整体偏低但不熄，靠很小的持续输入维持
archetypes.stanceEn: low overall yet not out — sustained by a very small continuous input

archetypes.stanceZh: 有明显的涨落节律，强弱随周期换位
archetypes.stanceEn: a clear rhythm of rise and fall, strength changing station by cycle

archetypes.stanceZh: 恢复与稳定这一侧厚，冲击面薄，守强于攻
archetypes.stanceEn: thick on the recovery-and-stability side, thin at impact — holds better than it strikes

archetypes.stanceZh: 冲击与反弹这一侧厚，持续面薄，攻强于守
archetypes.stanceEn: thick on the impact-and-rebound side, thin on duration — strikes better than it holds

archetypes.stanceZh: 表层看不出深浅，真正的量在下面，需要事情足够大才见底
archetypes.stanceEn: surface gives no reading of depth; the real volume is below, revealed only by something large enough

phases.stanceZh: 还没有真正被推动过，结构是完整的但未经使用
phases.stanceEn: not yet genuinely pushed; the structure is intact but untested

phases.stanceZh: 刚开始动，方向还不稳定
phases.stanceEn: just beginning to move, direction not yet steady

phases.stanceZh: 出现了裂口，通常也是第一次看清结构的地方
phases.stanceEn: a fissure has opened — usually also the first clear view of the structure

phases.stanceZh: 住在难受里但没有塌，这一段最长也最少被看见
phases.stanceEn: living inside the difficulty without collapse — the longest stretch, and the least witnessed

phases.stanceZh: 力的方向在改变，旧的用法开始不管用
phases.stanceEn: the direction of force is changing; the old way stops working

phases.stanceZh: 裂口在长，长回来的地方和原来不一样
phases.stanceEn: the fissure is closing, and closes back differently from before

phases.stanceZh: 经过一次之后变得更耐用，不是更硬
phases.stanceEn: more durable after passing through — not harder

phases.stanceZh: 这一轮结束了，结构回到可用状态，但已不是原样
phases.stanceEn: this round is over; the structure is usable again, and no longer the same
